keySentence: Real adventure always requires a little courage.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The cave was very dark. Their candle went out. Huck was scared. Real adventure always requires a little courage.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The cave was pitch black and full of strange, scary sounds. Bats flew around their heads and cold water dripped from above. When their candle went out, Huck started to panic in the dark. Real adventure always requires a little courage to keep going. Tom stayed calm and used his hands to feel along the walls. He knew they would find the way out if they did not give up.
